user.title: Pylontech US console
user.description: Select the serial port connected to the master battery's RS232 console port.

data_description.serial_port: Prefer a /dev/serial/by-id path so the port survives reboots.
data_description.baud_rate: US2000C, US3000 and US5000 consoles use 115200.

error.cannot_connect: No console prompt received. Check the cable, baud rate and that the battery is switched on.
error.invalid_response: The device answered but the response was not recognised as a Pylontech console.

abort.already_configured: This battery or serial port is already configured.

data.cell_poll_every: Read cell data every N polls
data.stat_poll_every: Read statistics and BMS clock every N polls

data_description.cell_poll_every: 0 disables per-cell polling after the first read.
data_description.stat_poll_every: 0 disables statistics polling after the first read.
